rs: Your contagious smile that brightens my whole world
The way you care and love with all your heart
You are like water to a little plant for my life
Tum ho toh mein hu — everything is meaningful with you
m:
Dear Aasha,

First of all Happy Birthday To You. Tumhare aaj janam din par mein bahut khush hu. Mein bata nahi sakta ki kitna bas ye khushi tumhare saath mein apne lifetime tak chahta hu. You're the best person in my life. Mein toh tumhare bina khudki life imagine hi nhi kr paaunga kyunki tum wo ho jaise ek nanhe se paudhe ko pani. Tum mere liye kitna important ye words me bayaan kr hi nhi sakta. Bas itna hi kahunga, tum ho toh mein hu.

And again enjoy the day cause ye tumhara din h.
Happy Birthday Donut ❤️
